title: Marketing Digital UX Co-Op – Summer 2027
note: Website UX co-op on Crown's marketing team working in Figma on the Core UI design system; no visa sponsorship.

facts.summary: Summer co-op supporting website design, usability and optimization projects.
facts.duties: Design system components and Figma assets, UX site audits, analytics and heatmap review, A/B test plans, journey mapping, web feature requirements and testing.
facts.requirements: Pursuing a degree in interactive media, web design, UX, digital marketing or related; UX and responsive web knowledge; Figma and Adobe; familiarity with Google Analytics/Hotjar. Crown does not sponsor; temporary-visa holders are not eligible.
